name: gcc-milestone-agent
description: CLI agent for GCC milestone verification using multi-source evidence and rule evaluation

scripts.demo: node src/cli.js --repo gcc-foundation/gcc-openclaw-grants --milestone "submission template, issue discussion, open source workflow" --since 2026-03-01 --out ./demo-report.md --json-out ./demo-report.json
scripts.demo:gcc: node src/cli.js --repo gcc-foundation/gcc-openclaw-grants --milestone "GCC allocation verification" --profile gcc-allocation --since 2026-03-01 --out ./demo-gcc-report.md --json-out ./demo-gcc-report.json
scripts.demo:html: node src/cli.js --repo gcc-foundation/gcc-openclaw-grants --milestone "GCC allocation verification" --profile gcc-allocation --since 2026-03-01 --out ./demo-gcc-report.md --json-out ./demo-gcc-report.json --html-out ./demo-gcc-report.html
